The following website contains a quick guide/cookbook for creating websites with quarto.

## Authoring a website

Once you have created your various quarto files you can create your website's html files with the following command in bash.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
quarto preview
```

::: {.callout-note}
Ensue you are in the main directory of your quarto project when running the above.
:::

You can host your html files through various means. I use the free service [GitHub pages](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/creating-a-github-pages-site).

## Creating quarto files

The various parts, sections, and pages of this website provide a quick guide and resources for creating a quarto website.
These include:

- [Setup](/setup/setup.qmd): Setting up quarto, VScode, and a quarto website project
- [qmd](qmds/qmds.qmd): Writing `.qmd` files with markdown
- [css](css/css.qmd): Setting the website theme, and the text font & colour
  - This shows the use of `.scss` files ([Sass: Syntactically Awesome Style Sheets](https://sass-lang.com/))
- [yml](yml/yml.qmd): Setting the format, structure, and other global options for the website
